appName: Walk the Plank & Save the cat

descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

displayName: Walk the Plank & Save the cat
display_name: Walk the Plank & Save the cat
display_long_description:
Do you have the courage to walk the plank hundreds of meters above the city… to save a helpless cat?
Save The Cat is a heart-pounding VR adventure but with a twist: it’s not just about walking on the plank, it’s about saving a life.

[media]
[media]

Step out from the elevator, look down at the dizzying height, and take your first shaky steps across the wooden plank. Every move counts — one wrong step and you’ll fall! But if you make it to the end… you’ll rescue the adorable cat waiting for you.


- VR Mode – Full immersion with real plank support for ultimate fear of heights with many levels.

- XR Mixed Reality Mode – See your real room as part of the game world.

[media]

- Realistic cat behavior and cute reactions when you save it.

- Dynamic city skyline, ambient sounds, and realistic depth.

- Perfect for friends, family, and VR challenges.
